name: scientific_writing
description: Scientific writing is an evidence-bound manuscript and report workflow primitive. Use it for drafting, revising, auditing, reporting-guideline coverage, claim-to-evidence binding, consistency checks, authorship and disclosure records, and submission preparation without fabricating scientific facts.
capabilities: Separate evidence verification, drafting, auditing, and human approval.
Bind factual claims and numeric statements to verified evidence IDs.
Track methods/results consistency, reporting guidance, authorship, declarations, and confidentiality boundaries.
Hand off document and figure delivery to output-format and visualization primitives.
requirements: Document type, study design, audience, target venue, and reporting guideline.
Verified source manifest, claim registry, methods/results records, and author approvals.
